about_the_game:
Dance your way through the first chapter of Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile set in the lively 1970s!
Play as Hercule Poirot as you're faced with unexpected events in a dancing club. Test your detective skills to unravel the mystery around the vanished ring on the dancefloor.

In Death on the Nile, a peaceful cruise on the Nile is disrupted by a terrible crime. Thankfully, famous detective Hercule Poirot is onboard.
Meanwhile, a private detective Jane Royce is tracking a murderer all around the world, her investigation leading her from London to Majorca, New York, and finally to Egypt.
The two investigations eventually collide at Abu Simbel. The dynamic duo then has to solve a complex case full of twists and turns.
Though the game is inspired by Agatha Christie's best seller, the story doesn’t end with the book and it still holds many mysteries and twists - even for Agatha Christie fans.

short_description: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into the first chapter in this demo!
